posts.headline: Championshipsovercoochie just keeps winning and the African Bald Fraud slander is officially on ice at 8-1 with a league-best 1269.1 points-for.
posts.detail: mjwithgoldhoops is averaging a 4th-place finish over two seasons, but none of that matters right now — this is the best record AND the best scoring output in Busters Anonymous, full stop.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's resume says dynasty, his 2026 says disaster, and Put it in Ra at 2-7 is the biggest gap between pedigree and performance in league history.
posts.detail: A 20-8 career record and 1.5 average finish over two seasons made him the gold standard, and now 929.86 points-for — dead last in the league — is an all-time face-plant that no GPA joke can even cover.

posts.headline: Thicks' Klint's Clipboard is 7-2 and still the most unconvincing contender in Busters Anonymous.
posts.detail: A title in year one bought a lifetime of benefit of the doubt, but 1026.8 points-for is barely top-half production — this ring is still coasting on fumes, not firepower.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Auntie Thomas's Easy Way or the Hard Way picked the hard way, and the Hard Way is winning at 3-6.
posts.detail: A 10th-place average finish last season set the floor and this year's 896.42 points-for — second worst in the league — is proving that floor was generous.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT is still winless at 0-9, and Eli's Ultimate Light Skin has turned this season into its own Book of Lamentations.
posts.detail: The man who once drafted a defensive player first overall now owns the league's longest losing streak, and 974.68 points-for proves the scripture jokes have run out of mercy.
